Company description: DHR (Generated via gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

Danaher Corporation, trading under the stock ticker DHR, is a globally diversified science and technology innovator that designs, manufactures, and markets professional, medical, industrial, and commercial products and services. Founded in 1969 as a real estate investment trust under the name DMG, Inc., the enterprise adopted the Danaher name in 1984 and transitioned into an industrial manufacturing firm. Over the subsequent decades, the company executed a strategic evolution, shifting its primary focus toward life sciences and diagnostics through a series of significant acquisitions, including Beckman Coulter in 2011, Pall Corporation in 2015, and the biopharma business of General Electric, now known as Cytiva, in 2020. Today, Danaher operates through three primary segments: biotechnology, life sciences, and diagnostics. The organization is widely recognized for its disciplined application of the Danaher Business System, a continuous improvement framework centered on lean management, operational efficiency, and sustainable growth.
